Maya (release-manager): Heads-up — planning a staggered change window for the summarizer rollout tomorrow 03:00-07:00 UTC. Want to tie the deploy to prompt/eval gating rather than a hard time hold.
Ron (eng-oncall): Sounds good. We should do regional canaries + eval checks before each region. Can we batch evals to reduce flakiness?
Tess (qa-lead): Agree on batching. Proposal: run 3 eval rounds per canary with different seeds, sample size 500 each, check Rouge/QA thresholds and hallucination regressions. If any metric drops >2.5% we auto-hold.
Sam (pm): What's the fallback? Pin previous model or roll forward with hotfix? Need a product decision upfront.
Maya (release-manager): Preference is conditional pin (keep old variant for affected routes) for up to 2 hours while we triage. Full rollback only if widespread degradation or safety regression.
Lee (frontend): Reminder — client-side feature flag gating is in place; we can split traffic by region+flag easily.
deploybot: deploybot triggered: preflight-eval-job started for model=rwd-summarizer-v2, canary=us-east-1, sample=500. See logs: https://ci/reports/3401234567
Tess (qa-lead): Quick note: include eval sub-suite for privacy redaction tests — tiny drift can be dangerous. Also add conversational coherence check.
Maya (release-manager): Good call. Add privacy-redaction and coherence to preflight. Also require human QA signoff if privacy test drops >0.5%.
Ron (eng-oncall): If deploybot signals "conditional-pin", what's the exact command to pin? Need runbook snippet.
Maya (release-manager): Runbook: 
```
# pin variant for route
rctl routing pin --route summarizer.prod --variant rwd-summarizer-v1 --duration 2h --reason "eval gate triggered"
```
Use that if deploybot announces: EVAL_GATE_CONDITIONAL_PIN.
releasebot: releasebot note: change window set 2026-03-21T03:00Z-07:00Z. Auto-promote disabled until manual signoff OR deploybot success signal.
deploybot: preflight round 1 complete: metrics OK except slight drop in coherence (-1.6%). round 2 starting.
Tess (qa-lead): Round 1: coherence drop is below manual-signoff threshold but above alert threshold. Will monitor.
Lee (frontend): Can we route 10% traffic to canary in parallel to get real traffic signals while evals run?
Maya (release-manager): Yes — start with 5% traffic for 30m, then evaluate telemetry + eval rounds. If both green, increase to 25%.
Sam (pm): I'll draft release notes: call out model variant, quantization change, known minor coherence variance in v2. Add mitigation steps for customers.
deploybot: preflight round 2 complete: metrics stable. Privacy-redaction test passed. Coherence round avg -1.2%.
Tess (qa-lead): Given current numbers, no automatic pin. Requesting 1 human QA quick sweep on 200 production-like samples.
Ron (eng-oncall): Oncall can run interactive bisect if we see spike later. Keep logs preserved: `s3://redwood-logs/preflight/3401234567/`
Maya (release-manager): Tess, can you sign off in 20m? If you don't, automatic hold will occur per policy.
Tess (qa-lead): Signing off — did the quick sweep, no privacy issues, coherence within acceptable range for canary.
deploybot: deploybot: canary promotion to 5% traffic complete. Monitoring hooks active.
releasebot: Note for release notes: customers in EU will be on canary at 04:00Z, APAC stagger at 05:30Z.
Lee (frontend): Saw a small uptick in 503s during the 5% shift in staging logs, investigating, probably autoscaling lag.
Ron (eng-oncall): I'll add a temporary autoscale buffer for the window: +2 GPU instances for 2 hours.
Maya (release-manager): If any eval round in subsequent regions shows >2.5% regression OR privacy drop >0.5% -> deploybot will trigger conditional pin automatically. Manual rollback if more than one region fails.
Sam (pm): Approved. Ensure release notes include rollback playbook and contact list.
Tess (qa-lead): Logging decision here: signoff given. Will keep monitoring through the window.
Maya (release-manager): Thanks. Final checklist: release notes drafted, runbook pinned (see runbook link), deploybot gating configured, autoscale buffer set. Going live tomorrow. :rocket:
releasebot: releasebot: scheduled notification will go out 1h before window start to #general and customer-facing channels.
